caption: Condition to complete Areas: Stump
content:
All the stumps @t{forest_gate.r} in the Area, if any, must sprout.
If two stumps @b{face each other} with @b{exactly one cell between them}, and @b{a road tile is placed on that cell}, the paired stumps will sprout.
Either stump may be placed outside the Area.

content.caption: Failed examples
content: e.g. 1: Stumps don't face each other.
e.g. 2: Two or more cells are between the stumps. There must be exactly one.
e.g. 3: There is no road between the stumps. There must be exactly one road.
